rule: Only fetched primary text or explicitly labelled abstract/bibliography. No unobserved quotation or numerical reference imported.

sources.title: SIMULIA Abaqus 2026: Defining the Initial Geometry of Conventional Shell Elements
sources.access: official HTML body, Offset: Reference Surface Versus Midsurface
sources.confirmed: Reference-surface DOFs and kinematics, offset as thickness fraction, membrane loading causing moments with nonzero offset.
sources.use: Keep reference/midsurface and work-conjugate force/moment labels explicit; not a proof of this Tri6 implementation.

sources.title: SIMULIA Abaqus 2026: *SHELL SECTION
sources.confirmed: Signed thickness-fraction OFFSET; SPOS/SNEG and default zero.
sources.use: Compare conventions only: this repository uses length e and x_p=x_s-e*n; do not equate numerical offset inputs between products.

sources.title: SIMULIA Abaqus 2026: Coupling Constraints
sources.access: official HTML body, Surface-Based Coupling Definitions
sources.confirmed: Kinematic coupling imposes rigidity; distributing coupling uses weighted average motion and accounts for reference-node offset.
sources.use: A different coupling model is a specification change. Do not change the corner point attachment to improve convergence.

sources.title: SIMULIA Abaqus 2026: Shell-to-Solid Coupling
sources.access: official HTML body, constraints and influence distance
sources.confirmed: Shell edge to solid surface uses distributing constraints; force/moment transfer is self-equilibrating; influence distance accounts for offset.
sources.use: Audit nodal force and moment transfer; this edge/surface transition is not the same as a plate bonded over a soil face.

sources.title: EDF Code_Aster U4.42.01, Mot cle COQUE
sources.confirmed: Signed distance between mesh and midsurface for DKT/DST/GRILLE_EXCENTRE; influence on bending and membrane coupling.
sources.use: Separate kinematic offset coupling from assumed transverse shear. Do not infer this implementation has the Code_Aster element formulation.

sources.title: EDF Code_Aster R3.07.06, Mise en oeuvre et post-traitements
sources.confirmed: Loads/couples and displacement conditions require reference-plane transforms; generalized resultants can be transferred to midsurface through POST_CHAMP/COQUE_EXCENT.
sources.use: Retain N/Mp/Ms and load application plane; check virtual work without replacing original definitions.

sources.title: Bentley PLAXIS: Modelling soil-structure interaction: interfaces
sources.confirmed: Without interface soil and structure are tied; interface node pairs allow slipping/gapping with elastic-perfectly-plastic interaction.
sources.use: Distinguish present bonded trace from an interface law. No hypothetical JOINT contribution can be supplied by the dry reference.

sources.title: Bentley PLAXIS: Frequently Asked Questions - Interface elements
sources.confirmed: Mechanical relative motion, hydraulic permeability/active-in-flow settings and structural-side selection are distinct choices.
sources.use: Document missing offset interface ownership, pressure and activity contracts; no defaults imported.

sources.title: Bentley PLAXIS: Initial degree of saturation for soil activated during staged construction
sources.confirmed: Newly activated soil initial saturation/pore pressure depends on chosen water condition and pore-pressure generation method.
sources.use: Explain why retaining inactive pore-array values does not define a new soil generation's initial state.

sources.title: Bentley PLAXIS: Regenerate staged construction
sources.confirmed: Soil/structure active state, assigned material and loads are phase-specific; global material parameter values are separate.
sources.use: Separate activation/deactivation/material assignment from material-state transfer and equilibrium.

sources.title: Bentley PLAXIS: Structural results in tables and curve plots
sources.confirmed: Structural stress-point extrapolation and smoothing can yield different nodal/table/curve values.
sources.use: Keep raw, recovered and smoothed quantities distinct; no smoothing introduced as acceptance.

sources.title: Bentley PLAXIS: Shear stress sign convention in interfaces
sources.confirmed: Interface shear sign depends on local axes, paired relative motion and previous-phase shear state; node and stress-point conventions can differ.
sources.use: Future interface comparison must specify owner, local basis, generation and output location, not nearest coordinates alone.

sources.title: Bathe and Dvorkin (1985), A four-node plate bending element based on Mindlin/Reissner plate theory and a mixed interpolation, IJNME 21, 367-383
sources.access: author-hosted full PDF, 17 pages, especially pp.368-371 and 380
sources.confirmed: Separate displacement/rotation and covariant transverse shear interpolation addresses thin-element locking; stress-resultant accuracy near large gradients needs refinement.
sources.use: Observe assumed shear versus raw displacement-gradient shear separately. Four-node paper is not a Tri6 offset-plus-soil convergence theorem.

sources.title: Zienkiewicz and Zhu (1992), The superconvergent patch recovery and a posteriori error estimates. Part 1: The recovery technique, IJNME 33, 1331-1364
sources.access: publisher bibliography and abstract only; full body not obtained
sources.confirmed: Abstract distinguishes recovered nodal derivatives from global L2 projection and reports element-dependent superconvergence.
sources.use: Bibliographic motivation only. Do not call the existing six-point Nedelec reconstruction SPR or import a convergence order.

sources.title: Maunder and Moitinho de Almeida (2018), Recovery of strong equilibrium from displacement-based finite element models of Reissner-Mindlin plates, IJNME 114, 375-398
sources.access: publisher bibliography and summary only; full body not obtained
sources.confirmed: Summary describes equilibrated stress recovery on overlapping star patches and complementary-energy comparison.
sources.use: Bibliographic motivation only; local reconstruction is not proof of whole-system balance and is not substituted for the original Q.
